column4: Loads counters.json at startup and wraps the store and file for the server; no allow or deny.
Pairs the counters' skip-if-busy save with their waiting save for the stop passes; scheduling only.
Runs the health history save behind its existing gate and reports whether it wrote; the gate decides, not this.
Pairs the health save's skip and wait variants for the stop passes; scheduling only.
Holds the classes a stop saves; constructor, no decision.
Spawns the once-a-second save passes once per stop; scheduling only.
Ends the passes and runs the last save of every class before a deadline; persistence timing, no access decision.
Starts each class's save on its own thread every second; scheduling only.
Instant arithmetic on the stop budget: Dp minus the last pass's slice.
Caps a drain's wait at the drain cap or the time left before the drains end; arithmetic.
Returns the stop budget's post-listener end; arithmetic.
Maps a save result to whether it wrote and logs a failed write; reporting only.
Builds the usage file's save pair for the passes; wiring.
Builds the transitions file's save pair for the passes; wiring.
Builds today's spend save pair for the passes; wiring, the enforcer itself is unchanged.
Lists the state classes a stop saves in pass order; wiring.
